query:
SELECT
                            c.sccache_generation AS generation,
                            c.is_public AS public,
                            o.private_caches,
                            o.storage_limit
                        FROM caches c
                        JOIN orgs o ON o.id = c.org_id
                        WHERE c.id = $1
                            AND c.org_id = $2
                            AND EXISTS (
                                SELECT 1
                                FROM cache_protocols p
                                WHERE p.cache_id = c.id
                                    AND p.protocol = 'sccache'
                            )
                        FOR SHARE OF c, o
